headline: NYY @ CLE matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is NYY 4.15 at CLE 3.08, with a projected total of 7.23. Batter research is strongest for Paul Goldschmidt, José Ramírez, Ben Rice, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Stuart Fairchild because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
